_what: Pinned revision record for the Phase I instrument. Satisfies pre-registration item 4 (model ID + commit + SHA256). Written 2026-10-04 from a real local run, not from documentation.
_authority: CURRENT_OBJECT.md; reasoning in docs/JEV_TOOLBOX_SELECTION.md; measurement in docs/PREDICT_SMOKE_TEST.md
_revision_note: The package's own reviewed pin. The mirror's main HEAD is 7b928d82c1e5b70ab3b1c70f2b5b0d8bb1cb76bc; the run resolves to 55cf4c4e, and the run prints the resolved revision itself.

runtime.install_route: C:/Python314/python.exe -m pip install -U laya  (PyPI reachable directly)

how_to_run.command: unset PYTHONPATH && export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com && C:/Python314/python.exe smoke_predict.py
how_to_run.offline_verified: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 produces a byte-identical stdout in 7 s wall time - the confirmatory path needs no network after the first download
how_to_run.required_workaround_pythonpath: A foreign venv on PYTHONPATH raises ImportError: cannot import name '_regex'. Unset PYTHONPATH; do not reinstall anything.
how_to_run.required_workaround_endpoint: huggingface.co times out on this host (measured); https://hf-mirror.com works.

interface_facts_measured.probabilities_available_for: choice and score; a noul returns a scalar P(true) plus a confidence
interface_facts_measured.confidence_agreement: the model's own `confidence` equals the protocol's section 3.3 c on all 9 questions probed
interface_facts_measured.truncation: usage reports no truncation and no collapsed options
interface_facts_measured.non_blocking_warning: one shipped temperature entry (choice:11+) is clamped out of range - it applies to no question in the smoke test

open_instrument_defect.what: The noul primitive is reported by the model card to sometimes follow its option labels rather than the state. It reproduced on this machine.
open_instrument_defect.evidence: 3/3 items returned a confident 'no' for escalate (c = 0.8783, 0.9698, 0.9358) INCLUDING an item written to be clearly vague and therefore escalate-worthy. The ok question also failed to track the state sensibly: the one clearly actionable item was the only sub-0.5 reading.
open_instrument_defect.consequence: Pin calibration C2 is now MANDATORY, not optional. Both Phase I noul questions (ok, escalate) are affected. The documented workaround - ask the same question as a two-option choice with neutral keys - must be evaluated on dev and frozen before the confirmatory run.
open_instrument_defect.status: OPEN. Not fixed, not worked around. Recorded so no confirmatory run starts on an untested noul.

what_this_pin_does_not_establish: It is not evidence for any protocol hypothesis; it fixes the instrument.
It is not a comparability claim against any other model, hosted or local.
Its behaviour on the Phase I item domain is measured on 3 hand-written items only - that is a smoke test, not a calibration.
